text.arabic_uthmani: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَٰهُ حُطَٰمًۭا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ

words.gloss_range: counterfactual conditional particle introducing an unrealized but live condition
words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) opens the ayah as a withheld possibility, not a neutral if. It makes the crop's non-destruction part of the point while keeping divine capacity live, and its scope reaches through the making clause into the human aftermath. The reader first enters a conditional frame, then hears the will, the rendering into debris, and the sustained reaction as one three-beat threat.

topics.headline: unrealized condition with live threat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the crop has not been destroyed, yet the grammar makes its destruction a present divine prerogative.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence identifies {{ar:لَوْ نَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:law nashāʾu}}) as a counterfactual protasis, so the threat is unrealized but syntactically live.

topics.headline: whole-scene conditional scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening particle governs not only material destruction but also the addressees' prolonged aftermath.
topics.reason: The clause analysis links protasis, apodosis, and result, preserving the three-beat progression opened by {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}).

words.gloss_range: divine willing as present sovereign capacity within the counterfactual protasis
words.root_gloss_range: will, wish, choose, determine, and thingness; local syntax selects sovereign determination rather than mere preference
words.prose: {{ar:نَشَآءُ}} ({{tr:nashāʾu}}) carries the divine We inside the verb and leaves the object of willing unspoken. Its imperfect indicative form makes willing a present renewable capacity, not a past decision. The following rendering verb narrows the root's broad will-and-thing field toward sovereign determination: if the will moved, the cultivated thing's state would change. The same formula recurs with water in 56:70, so crop and water stand under the same repeated provision-threat pattern.

topics.headline: divine subject and present capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the divine speaker is grammatically present inside the compact verb and that the willing remains presently available.
topics.reason: The verb is first-person plural imperfect indicative with no expressed object, supporting compact divine agency and ongoing capacity.

topics.headline: will narrowed to sovereign determination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not a bare wish; the will stands at the head of an outcome-changing chain.
topics.reason: The broad root family includes wishing and thingness, but the local apodosis with {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhu}}) selects effective determination over detached preference.

topics.headline: same-surah provision-threat refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the crop threat is paired with the later water threat rather than standing as an isolated example.
topics.reason: Rows with the concrete reference 56:70 preserve the same local refrain of divine willing and rendering across two provision domains.

topics.headline: divine agency before human reaction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement from divine agency to the addressees' affected state.
topics.reason: The first-person plural verb opens the action-chain whose later second-person plural verbs assign the aftermath to the addressees.

words.gloss_range: apodotic and emphatic response marker prefixed to the making verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the making verb to which the apodotic marker attaches

words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) marks the answer to the counterfactual and fuses it to the making verb. The particle keeps {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhu}}) from sounding like a detached assertion: it is the assured consequence if the opening condition were realized. Its small form is therefore a hinge from possible divine willing into completed hypothetical action.

topics.headline: answer marker with emphatic force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the making clause is syntactically locked to the opening condition and carries the force of assured consequence.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as the response lām, and attachment evidence marks the following verb phrase as the conditional apodosis.

words.gloss_range: rendered it; transformative making with pronoun object and result complement
words.root_gloss_range: make, set, appoint, create, render; local double-object syntax selects rendering into a new state

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the result complement of the rendering verb

words.prose: {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhu}}) is the ayah's transformation center. The suffix gathers the cultivated crop from the prior boundary into one patient, while the perfect verb presents the hypothetical act as complete once willed. The direct Form I verb binds the divine first-person agent and the crop patient in one compact surface form, without adding a heavier fabricated-making nuance. The double-object frame renders that object as {{ar:حُطَٰمًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥuṭāman}}), so the broad making-root is narrowed away from appointing or placing and toward conversion into debris. The same making root can yield different divine outcomes in the surah, including the water threat in 56:70 and fire as reminder in 56:73.

topics.headline: crop gathered into one patient
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object is not abstract ruin but the very cultivated crop carried forward by pronoun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence resolves the suffix as the cultivated object from the preceding crop discussion.

topics.headline: completed rendering into a result state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb does not merely make something happen; it renders an existing crop into a new state.
topics.reason: The root can cover making, setting, and appointing, but the pronoun plus accusative complement selects transformative rendering here.

topics.headline: direct Form I agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compressed agency relation: divine agent and crop patient are bound to one direct rendering verb.
topics.reason: The Form I perfect with subject agreement and object suffix is sufficient for direct rendering without a derived causative nuance.

topics.headline: same-surah making thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb belongs to a repeated surah-level making pattern with different outcomes.
topics.reason: The concrete references 56:70 and 56:73 keep this as a local recurrence of divine rendering, while 56:82 gives a later contrast with human making.

topics.headline: middle beat of catastrophe
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the verb as the hinge where invisible will becomes visible crop destruction.
topics.reason: The apodosis places {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhu}}) between volition and aftermath, making it the material transformation beat.

words.gloss_range: dry broken vegetation debris as the resultant state of the crop
words.root_gloss_range: breaking, crushing, shattering, and broken residue; local crop context selects dry organic debris

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the result connector after the debris noun

words.prose: {{ar:حُطَٰمًۭا}} ({{tr:ḥuṭāman}}) is the result complement: the crop would be rendered as debris, not merely damaged along the way. Its indefinite singular form treats many stalks and pieces as one unbounded residue-state. The root image is concrete and agricultural: organized growth becomes dry broken vegetation, with parallels in 39:21 and 57:20 and a wider crushing resonance by root in 104:4-5. Its clipped indefinite landing and heavy ḥ-ṭ-m articulation make the material collapse feel struck and compressed. Placed before {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}), the noun is the material endpoint that triggers the psychological aftermath.

topics.headline: result complement as residue-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices debris as the assigned outcome of rendering, with a possible circumstantial parse kept secondary.
topics.reason: The accusative noun is syntactically forced as the second object of {{ar:جَعَلْنَٰهُ}} ({{tr:jaʿalnāhu}}); a circumstantial reading is possible but less controlling.

topics.headline: dry broken vegetation image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ruin is pictured as dry broken crop-residue, not generic wreckage.
topics.reason: The crop context and low-occurrence vegetation profile narrow the root's crushing field to organic debris.

topics.headline: many pieces as one mass condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form collapses individual crop units into one unnamed debris condition.
topics.reason: The singular indefinite noun with tanwīn functions as a bare result category rather than a possessed or counted pile.

topics.headline: vegetation parallels and crushing resonance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare noun belongs to a repeated vegetation-collapse pattern while also carrying a wider crushing resonance.
topics.reason: The concrete parallels 39:21 and 57:20 stabilize the vegetation sense; 104:4-5 remains a root echo, not the local referent.

topics.headline: material endpoint before aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the debris noun is the heard endpoint of material change before the ayah turns to human reaction.
topics.reason: The noun closes the apodosis's material beat and stands immediately before the result connector.

topics.headline: crushing sound texture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a clipped, heavy noun landing at the point of material collapse.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows add audible pressure to the already supported crushing-residue image.

words.gloss_range: resultative and sequential connector linking debris to human aftermath

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the duration verb to which the connector attaches

words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) does not open a detached sentence. It carries the conditional answer forward from material ruin into psychological consequence: the crop becomes debris, so the addressees remain absorbed in reaction. The fused form before {{ar:ظَلْتُمْ}} ({{tr:ẓaltum}}) makes the aftermath arrive already connected to its cause.

topics.headline: causal sequence into aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human lament is caused by and sequenced after the debris, not merely placed beside it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final clause as a result, allowing both sequence and causality to survive.

topics.headline: fused boundary on aftermath verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the quick pivot from object-centered debris to addressee-centered remaining.
topics.reason: The connector is prefixed to the duration verb, making the transition visible on the surface form.

words.gloss_range: you would remain; durative auxiliary beginning the prolonged aftermath
words.root_gloss_range: remaining, continuing, shade, and shadowing; local Form I verb selects persistence, with shade imagery only as a secondary echo
words.prose: {{ar:ظَلْتُمْ}} ({{tr:ẓaltum}}) begins the aftermath beat by making the addressees remain in a state rather than register a single shock. Its perfect form stays inside the counterfactual chain, so the imagined aftermath sounds settled once the condition is entertained. With the following imperfect verb, it forms a continuous-aspect chain: they would keep on lamenting or wondering. The second-person plural suffix moves the ayah from divine We who will and render to human you who experience the result. Variant forms expose the geminate root behind the compact surface without changing the duration sense, while the shade branch remains a secondary echo of being left under the loss. That makes the root's less common verbal path visible within a field often heard through shade nouns.

topics.headline: durative auxiliary after debris
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reaction is extended remaining, not a momentary emotional flash.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats {{ar:تَفَكَّهُونَ}} ({{tr:tafakkahūna}}) as the predicate of the kāna-class duration verb.

topics.headline: perfect form under counterfactual force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the perfect form presents the imagined aftermath as settled once the condition is entertained.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect, but the law-chain governs it as part of the counterfactual result rather than a past report.

topics.headline: addressees become experiencers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the role shift from divine action to addressed humans as sufferers of the consequence.
topics.reason: The second-person plural suffix carries the human addressees without restating an independent pronoun.

topics.headline: compact geminate duration form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the compact surface is a contracted handling of the same geminate duration verb, not a different semantic path.
topics.reason: The variant rows expose fuller forms of the same root while preserving the durative function.

topics.headline: shade echo kept secondary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a shadow-like color around continued loss, while the local verb still means remaining.
topics.reason: Same-surah shade vocabulary at 56:30 and 56:43 gives an echo, but the local Form I verb and predicate construction select duration rather than literal shade.

topics.headline: verbal path in shade-heavy root field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah activates the root as a verb of persistence rather than another shade noun.
topics.reason: The distributional profile supports the claim that this verbal use is salient within a noun-heavy root field.

topics.headline: remaining tied to will and making
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that human remaining is part of the same conditional chain opened by divine will and rendering.
topics.reason: Pairing rows are locally coherent because the syntax moves from divine will and rendering into the human state; the contrast with 56:82 remains a later same-surah agency contrast.

words.gloss_range: you would keep lamenting, wondering, and self-involved over lost produce
words.root_gloss_range: fruit, enjoyment, jesting, and Form V grief over loss; local crop ruin selects lament while keeping enjoyment-loss irony audible

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: variant reading that clarifies regret or sorrow pressure

words.prose: {{ar:تَفَكَّهُونَ}} ({{tr:tafakkahūna}}) fills the remaining-state with an ongoing reaction. The object is left unstated, so the destroyed crop, the lost enjoyment, and the following lament in 56:66-67 can all enter the gap. The root's fruit and enjoyment field makes the grief sharper: the word associated with enjoyment becomes the verb for processing enjoyment lost. Form V internalizes the reaction, and the variant {{ar:تَفَكَّنُونَ}} ({{tr:tafakkanūna}}) confirms pressure toward regret without replacing the local surface. The doubled middle consonant and intensified onset variants give audible thickness to the self-involved lament, while the light f-k-h root sounds keep the enjoyment field faintly audible inside grief. The ayah closes on the addressees' collective continuing aftermath rather than on the debris itself.

topics.headline: ongoing predicate with open object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb's object is left open so the next speech can unpack the lament.
topics.reason: The verb is intransitive in the local frame and serves as predicate under {{ar:ظَلْتُمْ}} ({{tr:ẓaltum}}), while 56:66-67 supplies the following voiced complaint.

topics.headline: enjoyment root turned into loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that a fruit and enjoyment root becomes the word for grieving over the loss of produce.
topics.reason: The root's pleasure field survives as irony, while the crop-destruction context and Form V evidence narrow the local sense toward lament and self-reproach.

topics.headline: variant clarifies grief pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the variant reading exposes grief as an early pressure point in interpreting the surface verb.
topics.reason: The variant {{ar:تَفَكَّنُونَ}} ({{tr:tafakkanūna}}) supports grief as a control reading, but it does not replace the canonical local surface.

topics.headline: rare internalized Form V reaction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the morphology makes the addressees absorbed in processing the loss, and that this form is marked as rare.
topics.reason: QAC marks Form V, and the contextual profile lists this exact form as low-occurrence, supporting rarity without inventing a new sense.

topics.headline: enjoyment echoes inverted into lament
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earlier and wider enjoyment language returns here as deprivation language.
topics.reason: The same-surah fruit references at 56:20 and 56:32, plus enjoyment contrasts at 36:55 and 83:31, are contrastive echoes rather than the local sense itself.

topics.headline: ayah closes on human aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah's endpoint is sustained human response, not the crop debris alone.
topics.reason: The verb is the final word of 56:65 and opens into the voiced complaint in 56:66-67.

topics.headline: sound pressure around self-involved lament
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the geminated and light-sounding root sits tensely inside grief over lost enjoyment.
topics.reason: The phonological rows are retained as audible reinforcement of the morphologically and semantically supported lament.

topics.headline: plural addressee at closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah ends with the collective addressees still grammatically present.
topics.reason: The indicative plural ending continues the second-person plural subject already marked in the duration verb.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional sequence `nasha -> jaalnahu hutaman -> zaltum tafakkahun` joins imposed material change to a durative human response.
baseline_models.mechanism: Will assigns the pronominal object a new state: coherent material becomes dry fragments, while the causal `fa` transfers the scene from material breakage to speech that continues through the day. The result is not only a ruined object but a prolonged discursive aftermath.

activation_trace.role: Mishiah literally supplies will directed at a thing and initiates the counterfactual state change.
Making something assume a condition supplies the transition from an intact object to debris.
Breaking dry matter until it fragments supplies the material endpoint of the transition.
Continuing an action by day gives the reaction duration rather than a momentary exclamation.
Pleasant or witty conversation supplies the speech-domain aftermath, made dissonant by the preceding ruin.

changed_reading.before: A warning that an object could be destroyed, followed by human regret.
changed_reading.after: An imposed state change converts material coherence into fragments and leaves the humans caught in extended talk about the result.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: `Hutaman` and `tafakkahun` place dry broken matter beside a root whose inventory spans fruit, enjoyment, and sociable talk.
baseline_models.mechanism: The second half preserves the sound-field of desirable fruit and pleasure after the object has become their material opposite. A possible lexical irony converts expected fruit or enjoyment into only talk about what is gone; focus-only reading cannot yet decide whether that talk is amazement, bitter irony, or lament.

activation_trace.role: Dry fragmentation supplies the anti-fruit material condition.
Desirable fruit supplies the absent expected yield echoed inside the response verb.
Pleasure and ease supply the positive affect that the ruin reverses or makes bitterly incongruous.
Conversation supplies what remains when material fruit and its enjoyment disappear.

changed_reading.before: They would simply lament the ruined material.
changed_reading.after: The ruin is an anti-harvest in which fruit and enjoyment survive only as an ironic verbal echo.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence separates handling generative material, tilling, and sowing from creating and causing growth. The focus conditional then demonstrates the same boundary negatively: the party that can assign the grown object the state of dry debris controls the outcome beyond human cultivation.

activation_trace.role: Assigning a thing a condition anchors the focus as unilateral control over the crop's final state.
Dry fragmentation is the controlled negative outcome against which authorship is tested.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the disputed authorship pole in the repeated you-or-We question.
Seminal material from which a form is apportioned supplies a humanly handled input that is not identical with creating its outcome.
Casting seed and working the field supplies the limited human operation.
Causing a crop to sprout and grow supplies the outcome whose true agency the paired question contests.

structural_cues: 56:58-59 and 56:63-64 repeat an observed input followed by a you-or-We authorship question.
56:65 changes the pattern from disputed production to an uncontested counterfactual power over the result.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct input, labor, growth, and state-change terms; I infer an agency boundary between cultivation and causing the outcome. A live alternative is that all four verses are parallel proofs of power without a technical division of labor.

changed_reading.before: The focus threatens an isolated crop failure.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the negative test of a production claim: human tillage does not confer authorship over growth or its final state.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured death, replacement by counterparts, and new origination precede the field scene. The crop's passage into lifeless fragments becomes a small visible model of power over ending one organized form and originating or replacing another, so agricultural loss participates in the resurrection argument.

activation_trace.role: The loss of an organized dry body into fragments supplies the focus's visible terminal state.
Ordering an affair by measure supplies deliberate control rather than accidental decay.
Departure of force and life supplies the human-scale endpoint analogized by the crop's lifeless debris.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the replacement side of the transformation cycle.
Counterpart and likeness specify that replacement can preserve a type while exchanging an instance.
Originating a thing supplies the constructive power paired with reduction to debris.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Willed transformation can reverse growth into crumbled residue.** In `نشاء`, `ش ي ء` **B001** has two accepted variants; the **“willing”** variant is operative, not “knowable thing.” `ج ع ل` **B002** supplies turning into a state and `ح ط م` **B001** breaking a dry thing until it crumbles. **Abductive move:** I infer a reversible causal chain: the power that enables growth can instead assign disintegration. **Reading change:** crop stability is exposed as contingent transformation.

2. **Former enjoyment turns into agitated exultation or self-talk.** `ف ك ه` **B001** supplies pleasant ease, while **B006** supplies insolent exultance; the resultative `فـ` places `تفكهون` after crop-loss. **Abductive move:** I infer an ironic reversal in which the root of enjoyment now marks disturbed reaction rather than pleasure. **Reading change:** the same affective field that described garden fruit becomes unstable when production fails.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The parallel willing-and-making construction at 56:70 confirmed the reversible-transformation mechanism while changing the threatened output from debris to salt water.

The result is not only crop loss but interpretive collapse.

identity_judgment.rationale: Tek kaynak ifadesi, bir kişide kısalık, şişmanlık ve inatçı çekişkenliğin birlikte bulunmasını tek bir betimleyici anlam olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu üç kurucu niteliği doğru biçimde korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kuru ya da sert bir nesneyi kırarak parçalara ayırma eylemini ve bu eylem sonucunda ortaya çıkan kırıntıları birlikte doğrular. Geçici çerçeve bu temel işlem ile sonucunu doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, genel yok etmeden ziyade kuru veya sert bir nesnenin kırılıp ufalanmasına bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, herhangi bir özel tamlamadan anlam taşımadan kırma, parçalanma ve kırık döküntü çekirdeğiyle tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Kuru ya da sert bir nesneyi kırarak ufak parçalara ayırmak veya böyle bir nesnenin kırılıp parçalanmasıdır. Bunun sonucu olan kuru kırık döküntüler de aynı anlam alanına girer.

facets.statement: Kuru ya da sert bir nesne, bütünlüğü bozulacak ve parçalara ayrılacak biçimde kırılır.
Kırılma sonunda ortaya çıkan kuru parçalar ve döküntüler, işlemin sonuç ürünü olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, özellikle kuru ya da sert şeylerin kırılıp ufalanmasıdır; kırılmış kuru maddeden kalan döküntü de bu çekirdeğin sonuç anlamıdır.

concept_gloss.text: kuru ya da sert şeyi kırıp ufalama ve bundan kalan kuru döküntü
concept_gloss.applicability: Kırma işlemi ile kırılmış kuru maddenin parçalanma sonucunu birlikte temsil eden genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuru veya sert nesne, kırma işlemi ve parçalanma sonucu birlikte korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Nesnenin kemik, kabuk veya başka bir kuru sert madde olduğu eylem bağlamlarında doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlamın verdiği kuru sert nesne ile kırıp parçalara ayırma işlemini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sınırı kuru ya da sert nesnedir; komşu dal ise parçaların dağılıp saçılmasını öne çıkarır ve nesne türünü aynı biçimde sınırlamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Somut ve kuru bir nesnenin kırılarak küçük parçalara ayrılması temel işlemdir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, karşısına çıkan şeyi parçalayıp yok ettiği düşünüldüğü için böyle adlandırılan ateşi açıkça tanımlar. Ateşin şiddeti ile parçalayıcı etkisi dal kimliğinin ayrılmaz iki yönüdür.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal her ateşi değil, parçalayıp yok etme niteliğiyle adlandırılan şiddetli ateşi kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, özel bir tamlamaya bağlı olmadan yıkıcı etkisiyle adlandırılan şiddetli ateş anlamını taşır.

concept_map.definition: Karşısına çıkan şeyi parçalayıp yok eden şiddetli ateş için kullanılan addır. Kaynaklar bunu genel bir ateş, çok şiddetli ateş, Cehennem veya onun bir kapısı biçiminde sınırlar.

facets.statement: Şiddetli ateş, değdiği şeyi kırıp parçalayarak yok eden etkisi üzerinden adlandırılır.
Gönderge, kaynaklarda ateşin bütünü, çok şiddetli ateş, Cehennem veya onun bir kapısı olarak değişir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak açıklama, ateşin karşılaştığı şeyi parçalayıp yok etmesi nedeniyle adlandırıldığıdır; gönderge geniş ateş anlamından Cehennem'e veya onun bir kapısına kadar değişir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yıkıcı etkiyi ve ateş göndergesini birlikte taşıyan, kaynaklardaki gönderge çeşitliliğine açık karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ateş, olağanüstü şiddet ve karşılaşılan şeyi parçalayıp yok etme özelliği korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adın neden verildiğini açıklayan ve belirli bir inanç göndergesini adlandırmadan ateşin etkisini öne çıkaran bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Şiddetli ateşin karşısına çıkanı yok eden etkisini açık biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynaklarda değişen özel ateş ve Cehennem kapısı göndergelerini tek tek belirtmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ağır yıl ile kuraklığı bir arada verir ve bu dönemin insanları, malları ve genel olarak karşısına çıkanları çökertici etkisini adlandırma gerekçesi yapar. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sıradan bir takvim yılını değil, kuraklık ve yıkıcı sıkıntıyla belirlenen ağır yılı anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sürücü ya da çobanın hayvanlara karşı merhametsiz ve aşırı sert davranmasını, onları birbirine çarptırmasını ve iyi otlamalarına engel olmasını aynı kişi niteliğinin görünümleri olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve bu kişi ve davranış bağını doğru kurar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, özel bir tamlamaya bağlı olmadan hayvanlara sert davranan sürücü veya çoban niteliğini taşır.

concept_map.definition: Hayvanları aşırı sert süren veya güden, onları birbirine çarptırıp ezen ve gereği gibi otlamalarına izin vermeyen merhametsiz sürücü ya da çobandır.

Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat her kullanımın sınırı belirtilmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yaşlılık ve bedensel çöküş çekirdektir; uzun birliktelik yalnızca belirli kişi tamlamasında yaşlanmanın ortamıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yaşlı ve güçsüz atı belirten biçim ile hayvanın, yaşın veya yakınlar arasında geçen uzun sürenin özne olduğu tamlamalı kullanımları ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: İnsan ya da hayvanın yaşlılık, uzun ömür veya zayıflık yüzünden bedence çökmesi ve güçten düşmesidir. Atı doğrudan niteleyen kullanım ile yaşın, hayvanın yaşlanmasının veya yakınları arasında geçirilen uzun sürenin bu sonucu doğurduğu tamlamalar birbirine genellenmez.

facets.statement: Yaşlanma veya zayıflama, insan ya da hayvanın bedenini çökmüş ve güçsüz duruma getirir.
At, ileri yaş veya zayıflık nedeniyle çökmüş ve güçten düşmüş olarak nitelenir.
Belirli tamlamalarda yaş veya yakınları arasında geçirilen uzun süre, kişinin yaşlanıp çökmüş duruma gelmesinin nedeni olarak sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt, yaşlılık ve zayıflığın atı, başka bir hayvanı veya insanı çökmüş ve güçsüz hale getirmesini ortaklaştırır; özne ve neden, her söz diziminde ayrıca korunmalıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: İnsan ve hayvandaki yaşlanma kaynaklı bedensel çöküş çekirdeğini verir; özel tamlamaların katılımcıları ayrıca belirtilmelidir.

Dal korunabilir, ancak hayvan topluluğu ile yırtıcı saldırısı tek bir göndergeymiş gibi birleştirilmemelidir.

facets.statement: Kalabalık deve veya koyun sürüsü, ilerlerken karşısına çıkanları ve otlağı ezip tüketir.
Kısıtlı bir söz öbeğinde aslanın mala saldırması, zarar vermesi ve kırıp geçirmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt kalabalık sürünün karşılaştığı şeyi ve otlağı ezmesini temel görünüm olarak verir; aynı yıkıcı hareket alanında aslanın mala saldırısı için kısıtlı bir kullanım da bulunur.

Yapının eksik bırakılması veya kalabalığın birbirini sıkıştırması, yerin kendisi değil, adın kaynağına ilişkin farklı açıklamalardır; bu nedenle geçici görüntü yer kimliği merkez alınarak yeniden çerçevelenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel bir kırık ya da kalabalık yer değil, kutsal yapıya bitişik belirli mimari bölümdür.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak dal, özel bir tamlamaya bağlı olmadan belirli yerin geleneksel adı olarak tanımlanır; adın köken açıklamaları kimliğe dönüştürülmez.

concept_map.definition: Kutsal yapının yağmur oluğu tarafındaki belirli bölüm veya bu bölümün duvarıdır. Yapının dışında bırakılmış bölüm olması ve ziyaretçi kalabalığının sıkışması, adlandırmaya ilişkin farklı açıklamalardır.

facets.statement: Gönderge, kutsal yapının yağmur oluğu tarafındaki belirli bölüm veya bu bölümün duvarıdır.
Kaynaklar yeri kimi zaman belirli bölüm, kimi zaman onun duvarı veya yağmur oluğunun bulunduğu bölüm diye sınırlar.
Adın kökeni, bölümün ana yapının dışında ve eksik bırakılmasıyla ya da ziyaretçi kalabalığının sıkıştırıcı etkisiyle açıklanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt belirli kutsal bölgeyi ortak gönderge yapar; bölüm, onun duvarı ve yağmur oluğu tarafı betimleri aynı yerin sınırlarını gösterirken iki ayrı adlandırma açıklaması sunulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanımda çok ve durmaksızın yiyen kişiyi, başka bir kullanımda ise yiyeceği öğütüp sindiren diş, organ veya şeyi anlatır. İki görünüm, önüne geleni yok edercesine tüketme düşüncesinde birleşir.

facets.statement: Kişi, çok miktarda ve önünde kalanı tüketircesine yemekle nitelenir.
Öğütücü diş, sindirim organı veya benzer şey, yiyeceği parçalama ve sindirme işleviyle adlandırılır.
Çok yiyen kişi, önüne geleni yok eden şiddetli ateşe benzetilerek açıklanır.

Türemiş biçimler meyve sunmayı, meyve satmayı ve meyveyi tat alarak yemeyi anlatır.

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.
